What PCI DSS 4.0 evidence load costs is usually known only as a feeling. Turning that feeling into a signed number is the opening move; the engineering follows the evidence, never the other way round.
In Payments & Cards, named from the floor, not from a framework:

items: Continuous-compliance expectations replace annual snapshots; tokenization and segmentation evidence is assembled manually.
